datasets.name: DatSetExpCredits
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.numberofcredit, p.currency, p.personaltype, p.customertype,
       p.branchid, p.credittype, b.NAME, av.val_name,b.salary,(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where creditid=p.id) paydate,
       cm_common.accountnumber_get (a.contractaccid) AS contractaccno,c.duerest,
       cm_common.accountrest_get (a.booroweraccid) AS custaccrest,
       cm_utils.Get_PlanPrincipal (p.ID, :PDAT) AS principal,
          cm_utils.Get_PlanPrincipal(p.ID, :PDAT)
       + c.interestrest+  c.penaltyrest AS sumamt ,
        cm_utils.get_gecgun(p.ID, :PDAT) as expdatcount,
       c.dueinterestrest+c.penaltyrest penaltyrest, c.reserveid, cm_utils.get_creditplanrest (p.ID, :PDAT) AS plr,
       p.dateofconclusion as opendate,p.duedatefirstcontract as closedate,
       p.annualyinterestrate, cm_common.get_AccountBalance(a.contractaccid) as BalaccNo, p.boorowerid ,b.PHONENUMBER,
case when p.duedatefirstcontract<:PDAT and nvl(p.duedatelastcontract,'01-jan-2002')<:PDAT 
then 'Vaxt? bitib ' else ' - ' end as creditend,c.rest,c.interestrest,
g1.guarantorname,g1.zaminwork1,g1.zamintel1,g1.zmtelmob1,
g2.guarantorname name2,g2.zaminwork1 wr2,g2.zamintel1 evtel2,g2.zmtelmob1 mobtel2,
g3.guarantorname name3,g3.zaminwork1 wr3,g3.zamintel1 evtel3,g3.zmtelmob1 mobtel3
  FROM cm_active_credits p,
       cm_boorowerinfo b,
       cm_accounts a,CM_GUARANTOR g1,
       cm_curr_state c,CM_GUARANTOR g2,CM_GUARANTOR g3,
       avalute av
       
 WHERE b.creditid = p.ID and p.id=g1.creditid(+) and g1.cardid(+)=1
   AND a.creditid = p.ID and p.id=g2.creditid(+) and g2.cardid(+)=2
   AND c.creditid = p.ID and p.id=g3.creditid(+) and g3.cardid(+)=3
   AND av.valute = p.currency
  -- AND abs((cm_utils.get_creditplanrest (p.ID, :PDAT+1) - (c.rest+c.duerest)))>=0.5
and c.rest+c.duerest <> 0 and  cm_utils.get_gecgun(p.ID, :PDAT+1)>0
--and  cm_utils.Get_PlanPrincipal (p.ID, :PDAT)>0
--and p.intcalcmethod=0
ORDER BY :orderfield

datasets.name: DatSetPayments
datasets.sql:
SELECT paydate, 
       payedamt, 
       payedintamt, 
       payeddueamt,
       payeddueintamt,
       payedpenaltyamt
  FROM cm_payments
where creditid  = :CrdID
order by paydate

datasets.name: DatSetSchedule
datasets.sql:
SELECT  paymentdate, 
        principal, 
        interest
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
where creditid = :CrdID
order by paymentdate

datasets.name: DatSetTranches
datasets.sql:
SELECT 
      tranchedate, 
      trancheamount
  FROM cm_tranches
where creditid  =:CrdID
order by tranchedate

datasets.name: DatSetInterests
datasets.sql:
SELECT hdate, 
       interest, 
       dueinterest, 
       nvl(penaltyinterest,0) as penaltyinterest
  FROM cm_interests
where CreditID = :CrdID
order by hdate

datasets.name: DatSetReserves
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, description||' - '||PERCENT as description
  FROM cm_reserves

datasets.name: DatSetExpCredits_
datasets.sql:
select
    p.id,
    p.numberofcredit,
    p.currency, p.personaltype, p.customertype,p.branchid, p.credittype,
    p.dateofconclusion as opendate,
    p.duedatefirstcontract as closedate,
    p.annualyinterestrate,p.boorowerid ,b.PHONENUMBER,b.salary,
    lacc.acc_no as contractaccno,
    cust.name,
    p.dateofconclusion,
    p.duedatefirstcontract,
    p.duedatelastcontract,
    expcrd.outdat,
    psh.planrest, 
    expcrd.exdatcount,
    av.val_name,
    br.ostat as custaccrest,
   /* case 
    when nvl(planpay.pay,0) - nvl(realpay.realpay,0)  <= 0 then 0  
    else nvl(planpay.pay,0) - nvl(realpay.realpay,0) 
    end as principal,
 
    case 
    when nvl(planpay.payint,0) - nvl(realpay.Realpayint,0)  <= 0 then 0  
    else nvl(planpay.payint,0) - nvl(realpay.Realpayint,0)
    end as interest,


    case 
    when nvl(planpay.pay,0) - nvl(realpay.realpay,0) +
    nvl(planpay.payint,0) - nvl(realpay.Realpayint,0)  <= 0 then 0  
    else nvl(planpay.pay,0) - nvl(realpay.realpay,0) +
    nvl(planpay.payint,0) - nvl(realpay.Realpayint,0)
    end as sumamt,*/


    
       cm_utils.Get_PlanPrincipal (p.ID, :dat) AS principal,
       cm_utils.Get_IntPlanPayment (p.ID) AS interest,
         cm_utils.Get_PlanPrincipal(p.ID, :dat)
       + cm_utils.Get_IntPlanPayment(p.ID) AS sumamt,
    c.penaltyrest, 
    c.reserveid,  
    cm_common.get_AccountBalance(a.contractaccid) as BalaccNo
from
   cm_portfolio p,
   cm_loanaccounts lacc,
   cm_sb_customers cust,
   sb_avalute av,
   cm_boorowerrest br,
   cm_boorowerinfo b,
   cm_curr_state c,
   cm_accounts a,
   
 (select 
   psh.creditid,
   sum(psh.principal) as pay,
   sum(psh.interest) as payint
  from cm_payment_schedule psh 
  where psh.paymentdate<=:dat 
group by psh.creditid) planpay,

(select 
   pay.creditid,
   sum(pay.PAYEDAMT+pay.PAYEDDUEAMT) as Realpay,
   sum(pay.PAYEDINTAMT+pay.PAYEDDUEINTAMT) as Realpayint
  from cm_payments pay 
group by pay.creditid) realpay,
      
(select  creditid, null as outdat,0 as exdatcount from(
select id as creditid
from   cm_portfolio

minus

select psh.creditid
from   cm_payment_schedule psh ,cm_curr_state cs
where  psh.rest < (cs.rest+cs.duerest) and (cs.duerest+cs.rest - psh.rest >= 0.5) 
and psh.creditid = cs.creditid
and psh.paymentdate <=:dat
group by psh.creditid)

union
select psh.creditid,min(psh.paymentdate)  as outdat,cm_utils.bankdaysbetween (MIN (psh.paymentdate),
                                   :dat
                                  ) AS exdatcount
from   cm_payment_schedule psh ,cm_curr_state cs
where  psh.rest < cs.rest+cs.duerest and (cs.duerest+cs.rest - psh.rest >= 0.5) 
and psh.creditid = cs.creditid
and psh.paymentdate <=:dat
group by psh.creditid
) expcrd , 


(SELECT  creditid, rest as planrest,principal, interest
  FROM cm_payment_schedule where paymentdate = :dat
  union
   select  creditid , 0 as planrest, 0 as principal, 0 as interest from 
  (select id as creditid 
  from cm_portfolio
  minus
  SELECT  creditid
  FROM cm_payment_schedule where paymentdate = :dat)) psh

where p.id = lacc.creditid  and 
      p.boorowerid = cust.id and
      p.id = c.creditid and
      c.rest + c.duerest <> 0 and
      p.id = psh.creditid and
      br.creditid = p.id and
      expcrd.creditid = p.id and 
      b.creditid = p.id and
      a.creditid = p.id and 
      p.currency = av.valute and
      p.id=planpay.creditid(+) and
      p.id = realpay.creditid(+)
      order by :ORDERFIELD
